cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

mechanism: A uses professional installation-stage distinctions to describe an unsupported cupboard as complete, then redefines a single fitted shelf as the finished deliverable.
confusable: Ordinary delay admits work remains; A must sincerely sell the incomplete state as a deliberate form of completion.
comparison: Report alternative changes document editions to cover absent content; cupboard alternative changes installation stages to cover absent supports.
seedUse: Loose shelves, missing supports and paid installation derive from D41-a; S03 adds technical correction of fixed versus adjustable delivery.
